newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia sees London Club deal closure in Q1 1997.
newsitem.headline: Russia sees London Club deal closure in Q1 1997.

text.p: The closure of the deal rescheduling Russia's commercial bank debt is not likely to take place until the first quarter of 1997, the Russian finance ministry said on Monday.

"Due to the unprecedented volume of secondary market trading of eligible debt, the reconciliation process is taking longer than anticipated, and it is now expected that the closing of our London Club arrangements will tke place in the first quarter of 1997," it said in a statement.
